## Install

1. Download **Sothis-Setup.exe** below.
2. Double-click it. Sothis installs in a few seconds and opens; no admin needed.
3. If Windows says "Windows protected your PC", click **More info → Run anyway** (the installer isn't code-signed).

Sothis keeps itself up to date after that. Your settings and sign-ins stay on your own PC (`%APPDATA%\Sothis`).

## New in 1.3.1

- Sothis hides itself from your clips while recording (Settings → Clips → Hide Sothis from clips)

## New in 1.3.0

- Mic noise suppression for clips: Strong (AI, RNNoise) or Light, in Settings → Clips
- Clips keep game sound and your mic on separate tracks, so the clip editor can turn each up, down or off
- Game and mic volume and mute in the clip editor

## New in 1.2.1

- Dragging files out of the Files page works on clip cards too

## New in 1.2.0

- Clip sound stays in sync with the video (no more delayed or choppy audio)
- Game sound and mic volume sliders with mute buttons for clips (Settings → Clips)
- Sound timing nudge if a clip's sound is ever a little early or late
- Clips show only the game window when the game isn't full screen
- Drag clips, videos, music and photos out of the Files page into Discord or any folder
